articles.title: How AI Is Changing the Way Students Learn

articles.whyRecommended: This fits Rudy Daily because it connects technology, education, and responsible AI use, while using clear explanatory English that is useful for exams and future study.

articles.title: Why Social Media Feels So Hard to Leave

articles.title: The Small Rituals That Make a Cafe Feel Like Home

articles.title: Finding Your Own Voice in a Second Language
articles.summary: This article reflects on how learners develop clearer expression by reading, noticing patterns, and speaking from real interests.
articles.whyRecommended: It matches the core philosophy of Rudy Daily: meaningful input first, gradual pattern absorption, and English that becomes an extension of the learner's own mind.
